title: Channel‑Stitch Playbook and Staggered Launch Timeline for Inference Console Update
creator: Marco Ruiz
description:
Purpose: Coordinate a staggered, cross-channel announcement for the Console 2026.03 release with clear owner responsibilities, embargo windows, and a consolidated release notes summary. This ticket produces a single source launch playbook (channel-stitch) that marketing, docs, support, and eng can follow.

Scope: blog post, product email, social (X, LinkedIn), webinar (EMEA + NA windows), in-console banner, release notes page, and support FAQ. Excludes paid ads and partner co-marketing (tracked in PM-57201).

Recent decisions and trade-offs: We will do a two-wave rollout (EMEA morning window, NA afternoon window) to maximize regional coverage while keeping a single canonical blog post. Timezone staggering adds 4 hours of runway for support and last-minute bugfixes, which increases ops cost for on-call by one 8‑hour rotation. We accepted this for improved live-demo attendance and global signal.

Observed risks: last-minute doc diffs may drift release notes; mitigations include a freeze at T-48h and a documented quick-change PR flow under GitHub PR #7890. If critical doc changes occur after freeze, we will add an "update note" to the release notes page instead of modifying historical content.

Deliverables: playbook (this doc + assets checklist), embargo table with channel times, finalized release notes delta, webinar runbook + dry run checklist, support FAQ, social creative and captions, email HTML and segmentation list, in-console banner copy and link mapping.
